product_brief: Hardware HSM IP integrating classical and postquantum cryptography for secure key management and highperformance cryptographic services for ECUs.
pqc_capability_description: Integrates classical and postquantum cryptography. Supports ML-KEM (KeyGen, EncapDecap), ML-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer), and SLH-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer). Validated on Xilinx Kintex-7 XC7K325T.
crypto_primitives: AES-CBC, AES-CCM, AES-CFB1, AES-CFB128, AES-CFB8, AES-CMAC, AES-CTR, AES-ECB, AES-GCM, AES-GMAC, AES-OFB, AES-XTS, ECDSA, EDDSA, Hash DRBG, HMAC-SHA2-256, HMAC-SHA2-384, HMAC-SHA2-512, HMAC-SHA3-256, HMAC-SHA3-384, HMAC-SHA3-512, KDF IKEv1, KDF IKEv2, KDF KMAC Sp800-108r1, KDF SP800-108, ML-DSA, ML-KEM, RSA, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512, SHAKE-128, SHAKE-256, SLH-DSA
fips_validated: Yes (First Validated: 3/30/2026; Algorithms reference FIPS 186-4, FIPS 186-5, FIPS 202)
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Designed for ECUs (Electronic Control Units); implemented on Xilinx Kintex-7 FPGA.
